code='''def transform(grid):
    # Keep the large filled rectangle; isolated marks are noise.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    colors = set(x for row in grid for x in row if x != bg)
    best = None
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        area = (r1-r0+1) * (c1-c0+1)
        score = len(pts) / area * area**0.5
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, color, r0, r1, c0, c1)
    _, color, r0, r1, c0, c1 = best
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
